s: Dine niqquy veqippul habbegadim beshabbat ubo k"h seipim: hamnaer tallit chadasha shechora min hattal shealeha — chayyab, mippene shenniurah min hattal hu meyappeh umoil lah kemo kibbus. Vehu shemmaqpid aleha shello lelobshah belo niur, abal im eno maqpid aleha, sheap im lo haya menaarah lo haya nimna millelobshah — en yippuy zeh chashub etzlo kekibbus, umuttar lo lenaarah qodem sheyyilbashenna. Abal im hi lebana o adumma o shear mine tzibonim o sheenah chadasha — en hanniur yapeh lah kemo kibbus, velaken muttar lenaarah ap im maqpid aleha shello lelobshah belo niur. Vead ematay niqret chadasha? Kol zeman shello nishtammeshu bah kol kak ella adayin hi bechiddusha:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Betal, abal im yaredu geshamim (harbeh) al shum beged, ben laban ben shachor ushear mine tzibonin, vekol shekken im napal bemayim, hoil venibleu bo mayim — asur lenaaro, mippene shedderek kol beged balua mimmayim keshemmenaarin oto nischatin mimmennu mayim. Vehu shehabbeged chadash, shemmin hassetam hu maqpid alayv beyoter lenaaro miyyad mippene shemmitqatztzer bemayim, abal im eno maqpid alayv — muttar lenaaro (sheap im yischot mimmennu hammayim — hare eno mitkavven lekak, vedabar sheeno mitkavven muttar. Abal keshehu maqpid alayv lenaaro — azay hu kipsiq resheh velo yamut, sheqqarob levadday sheyyissachatu hammayim mimmennu beniuro). Veyesh mi sheoser ap im hu beged yashan sheeno maqpid alayv. Vetob lachush lidbarayv:

Yesh mi sheomer sheasur lenaer beged chadash veshachor min heapar o haabaq shealayv im maqpid shello lelobsho belo niur, mishshum shehu kekibbus, shehaabaq meqalqel marito veniuro mimmennu hu kibbus. Vetob lachush lidbarayv. Abal muttar lehasir hannotzot min habbeged, sheen hannotza debuqa babbeged kemo haabaq veheapar, veen hasaratah doma kelal lekibbus. (Veen issur bahasarat hannotzot mishshum tiltul muqtzeh, lepi shemmin hassetam kebar hayu bekar o bekeset venapelu mehen al habbeged, vahare hen reuyot lehachaziran lahen velishkab alehen, ulekak enan muqtzot kelal. Abal notzot shelemot sheenan reuyot lekar vekeset ad sheyyimrot otan miqqanim shellahen shehem qashim veenam reuyim lishkab alehen — asur letaltelan beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"t leinyan yom tob). Veim muttar lahasiram al yede makbedet haasuya miqqesamim — yitbaer besimman shl"z. Veken im yashab lo zera pishtan o tabshil al kesuto — muttar leqallepo:

Haqqorea al menat lachazor velitpor al derek shennitbaer besimman ra"ch — chayyab, shehu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan yeria shennapal bah tolaat umenaqqeb bah neqeb qatan veagol, ukede letopro tzarik liqroa lemala ulematta et hanneqeb, shello tehe hattepira asuya qematim qematim. Vehaqqorea shello al menat lachazor velitpor — patur, abal asur middibre soperim. Lepikak mi shennistabbeku begadayv beqotzim — maprishan betzina, umitmahmeah kede shello yiqqareu. Veim niqreu — en bekak kelum, kevan shello nitkavven lekak, veen kan pesiq resheh, shekkevan shehitmahmeah haya epshar shello yiqqareu. Umuttar liptzoa et haegoz bematlit veen chosheshin shemma tiqqara, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"ch:

Derek haumanim haosim kele matteket lehakkot bappattish al hakkeli achar shennigmar kede lehashvot aqmimuto behakkaa zo, vehakkaa zo hi gemar meleket hakkeli, vehu ab melaka shehayeta bikle hammishkan. Vekol haoseh shum dabar shehu gemar asiyyat hakkeli vetiqquno — hare gemar zeh nechshab limlaka, vehu toledat "makkeh bappattish" shehaya bammishkan, kegon hatztzar tzura bikli haomed letzayyero, apillu lo tziyyer ella miqtzat hatztzura — hare asa miqtzat gemar hakkeli vechayyab, sheap shehatztziyyur mitztzad atzmo eno chashub melaka, mikkol maqom akshav shehakkeli nigmar venitqqan al yado — hare hu nechshab limlaka. Veken kol haoseh ezeh tiqqun likli — hare tiqqun zeh nechshab limlaka vechayyab. Veen tzarik lomar haoseh keli mittechillato, shechayyab mishshum "makkeh bappattish", ap im hu beinyan sheen bo mishshum boneh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"d vesimman shk"b:

Lepikak, halloqet yabbelet sheal gabbe habbegadim, kegon ellu hayyabbalot shebbikle tzemer hannisharim bahem min haariga, veken qashshin veqesamim daqqin shenneergu babbeged shello bemitkavven, hannotel otam leachar haariga — chayyab mishshum "makkeh bappattish" im hu maqpid alehem, dehaynu shehu mesirem bekavvana kede leyappot habbeged, sheyyippuy zeh hu chashub gemar asiyyat habbeged vetiqquno, lepi shemmaqpid alehem. Abal im eno maqpid alehem veeno mesirem ella derek mitasseq beolma — patur, abal asur middibre soperim:

Shelal sheosim hachayyatim, dehaynu shebbitchillat tepiratam mechabberim bechutin et elyonut habbeged im mah shettoperim tachtayv, veachar gemar tepiratam motzi chutin ellu min habbeged — yesh lehistappeq im hammotziam beshabbat chayyab mishshum makkeh bappattish im maqpid alehem, veim asur middibre soperim im eno maqpid alehem. Veyesh lehachamir:

Muttar leqappel habbegadim qodem lebishatam kede sheyyitpashshetu miqqematehem veyihyu mehuddarim alayv kesheyyalbishem, vehu sheyyalbishem bo bayyom. Veken achar shellebasham upeshatam mealayv — yukal lachazor uleqappelam im dato lachazor ulelobsham bo bayyom, shennimtza qippul zeh hu letzorek hashshabbat. Abal im en dato lachazor ulelobsho ad lemotzae shabbat — asur leqappelo beshabbat (mittaam sheyyitbaer). Velaken asur leqappel hattallit shel mitzva shepposhetin beshabbat shacharit bimqomot sheen chozerin umitattepin bahem bemincha:

Lo hittiru leqappel apillu letzorek hashshabbat ella beadam echad, abal shenayim lo yeqappelu beged echad, mippene shekkesheshshenayim meqappelim hen mapshitim qematayv (bidehem beqippulam), venirin kimtaqqenin kelim beshabbat (mah sheen ken kesheechad meqappel mitpashshetim haqqematim mealehen). Vaapillu beadam echad lo hittiru ella bibgadim chadashim, abal lo bishanim, shehayshanim qippulam metaqqenam yoter min hachadashim, shehachadashim qashim mealehen veen memaharin liqmot. Vaapillu bachadashim lo hittiru ella bilbanim, abal lo bitzbuim, shehatztzebuim qippulam metaqqenam yoter. Vaapillu bilbanim lo hittiru ella kesheen lo beged acher mequppal lehachalip hayyom, sheaz hittiru lo mishshum kebod shabbat shello yelek bibgadim meqummatim, abal im yesh lo beged acher mequppal — asur leqappel et zeh, mishshum sheal kol panim nireh qetzat kimtaqqen keli beshabbat. Veyesh mi sheomer shelleqappel shello keseder qippulo harishon — muttar bekol inyan, ap (letzorek machar), ubishne bene adam, vehu beged yashan vetzabua, veyesh lo lehachalip, lepi sheen leqippul zeh shum qiyyum, veen kan shum tiqqun keli kelal. Venirin debarayv:

En matztziin hammitta mishshabbat lemotzae shabbat, ap al pi sheyyesh shahut bayyom sheyyukal lishan aleha beshabbat atzmo, mikkol maqom kevan sheen dato lishan aleha ad lemotzae shabbat — hare hu mekin mishshabbat lechol, veasur middibre soperim. Umikkol maqom, im hammitta omedet bacheder sheddar sham veyesh bizzayon vedabar megunneh hu im taamod kak belo hatztzaa — muttar lehatztziah, shezzehu gam ken letzorek hashshabbat velikbodo. Umatztziin millel shabbat leshabbat, apillu eser mittot veyoter, sheim yitztarek lishan beachat mehen — yishan. Umikkol maqom, tob yoter lehatztzian meereb shabbat (ayyen simman rs"b):

Makbesh, vehu keli shekkobeshin bo habbegadim achar hakkebisa, vehen shette luchot zeh al zeh vehabbegadim benehem, veammudim menuqqabim qebuim bearba zaviyyot shel luach hattachton, ukenegdam yesh neqabim balluach haelyon bearba zaviyyotayv, vetochabin haammudim beniqbe haelyon, umoridin haelyon lematta al habbegadim lekobshan, veachar kak tochabin yetedot beniqbe haammudim shello yaaleh haelyon lemala — muttar lehattir makbesh zeh beshabbat, dehaynu littol haytedot mehaammudim ulepotcho littol mimmennu habbegadim letzorek shabbat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemakbesh shel baale battim, abal makbesh shel kobesim — asur lehattiro, mippene shehu tachub bechozqa vehattarato doma listira. Vaapillu im haya muttar kebar meereb shabbat — asur lishmot mimmennu begadayv lelobsham beshabbat, gezera shemma yabo lehattiro beshabbat:

Chaluq leachar kebisa hu mitqashsheh, umeshapshepim oto beyadayim lerakkeko, veap hallibbun shello matzhil yoter al yede shipshup zeh — ap al pi ken muttar leshapshepo beshabbat veeno nireh kimlabben, lepi shehaddabar yadua shekkavvanato bishbil lerakkeko velo bishbil lehatzhil hallibbun, sheen adam maqpid kol kak al libbuno vetzihulo shel chaluq shehu beged tachton. Abal hassudar shehu beged elyon veadam maqpid yoter al libbuno vetzihulo — asur leshapshepo beyadayim, mippene shennireh kemitkavven lehatzhil hallibbun, vahare zeh domeh limlabben. Veyesh omerim shello hittiru ap bechaluq ella keshehu shel tzemer o shel meshi, abal shel pishtan, veken kol shear kele pishtan — asur leshapshepam apillu meat beyadayim kede lerakkekam, mippene sherikkukam zehu libbunam. Venakon lachush ledibrehem, kevan shehu dabar sheen bo tzorek kol kak. Uminhag haolam lehaqel leshapshepam beyadayim lerakkekam (ella shennizharin lerakkek bikli hammeyuchad lekak):

Asur laasot qematim baanaq shebbetzavvar sheqqorin (qalne"r) beetzim hammeyuchadim lekak. Veken haqqematim sheosot hannashim bebatte zerootehem — asurot laasot beshabbat veyom tob, vaapillu bechullo shel moed, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"t vetaqam"a:

Tit sheal raglo o al minalo — meqannecho bekotel, abal lo baqqarqa, gezera shemma yashveh gumot shebbaqqarqa bekavvana, lepi shedderek adam lechazzer achar meqom guma leqanneach bo raglayv shehattit mitqanneach sham heteb, umittok shehu asuq leqanneach — yesh lachush shemma yishkach shehu shabbat vikavven lehashvot haggumot beqinnucho. Veyesh mattirin ap baqqarqa, sheen chosheshin sheyyashveh gumot bemitkavven, veim hushvu haggumot mealehen al yede qinnucho — en bekak kelum sheddabar sheeno mitkavven muttar. Veyesh oserin ap bekotel shel choma, mippene shennireh kemosip al habbinyan. Uleinyan halaka — bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, umuttar leqanneach min haddin ben baqqarqa ben bekotel shel choma, ella shellekattechilla tob leqanneach baqqora o bekotel shel etz shehu muttar ledibre hakkol, veken bachatikat cheres hammutteret betiltul, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch. Veim en lepanayv echad mikkol ellu — yoter tob leqanneach bekotel apillu shel choma milleqanneach baqqarqa, mippene sherabbu hammattirin al haoserin leqanneach bekotel shel choma:

Hamemacheq et haor, dehaynu shemmegarer et hatztzemer o hassear meal haor ad sheyyachaliq pene haor — chayyab, vehu meabot melakot, shekken hayu osin bammishkan beorot techashim veelim meaddamim. Lepikak, en megordin sandal o minal, ben chadash ben yashan, apillu begab hassakkin, veen tzarik lomar bechuddo o betzipporen, mippene sheqqolep et haor meat, vahare zeh memacheq:
Lepikak, hannohagim leqanneach minalehem babbarzel haqqabua lipne petach bet hakkeneset — lo yapeh hem osim, shehare hu chad kemo gab hassakkin, velaken tzarik laasoto ab verachab berosho:

Tit sheal gabbe bigdo — lo yeshapshepo mibbachutz (dehaynu bimqom hattit), mippene shennireh kimlabben, ella yeshapshepo mibbipnim. Ketzad? Loqeach habbeged mibbipnim (dehaynu betzad hb' keneged hattit) umeshapshepo, sheaz en haddabar nikkar kol kak shemmaabir et hattit sheyyehe nireh kimlabben. Veyakol gam ken legared hattit betzipporen o besakkin apillu bechuddo, sheen lachush bebeged limemacheq. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betit lach, abal betit yabesh — yesh omerim sheapillu leshapshepo mibbipnim asur, veen tzarik lomar legordo, mippene shettit hayyabesh mitparer leperurim daqqim al yede shipshup o gerida, vahare zeh keen toledet hattochen, shemmechalleq gup echad legupim daqqim harbeh, veasur middibre soperim. Abal min hattora en issur, kevan sheeno tzarik legup dabar hammitparer venitchan. Veap lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyab aleha, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno tzarik legup dabar hammitparer — en perur zeh toledet hattochen, sheen derek litchon ella keshetztzarik legup dabar hannitchan:

Bammeh debarim amurim sheasur middibre soperim? Kesheyyesh sham mammashut hattit, shekkeshemmegordo nopelim mimmennu perurim zeh domeh letochen, abal im en sham ella mareh hattit umegared sham lebattel hammareh — en zeh domeh letochen, umuttar. Veken mi shebbigdo metunnap qetzat veen sham mammashut hatztzoa ella hammareh bilbad — yakol legared sham lehasir hammareh kede lehitpallel binqiyyut, ap al pi shemmuttar lehitpallel kak belo gerida, kemo shennitbaer besimman a"v:

Minal o sandal sheyyesh alayv tit o tzoa — muttar leshaksheko bemayim lehaabiran mealayv. Veken shear kol kele or shennitlakleku — muttar litten alehem mayim lehaabir hallikluk, o leshaksheko bemayim ad sheyyaabor, veen bezeh mishshum kibbus, sheen kibbus beor beshikshuk lebaddo. Abal asur leshapshepo tziddo zeh al tziddo zeh leachar shebbau alayv mayim, shezzehu kibbus gamur, veasur gam beor (middibre soperim, abal min hattora eno chayyab ap im sechato achar kak):

Abal beged sheyyesh alayv ezeh likluk, kegon tippat dam o roq, vekol shekken tit o tzoa, im natan al maqom hamluklak mayim (o shear mashqeh hamlabben) apillu kol shehu — chayyab, ap al pi shello shikshek kelal, lepi sheshsheriyyat beged zehu kibbuso. (Vaapillu shear mashqim sheenam melabbenim ella melaklekim — ap al pi ken asur littenam al meqom hallikluk lehaabiro, mittaam sheyyitbaer). Ella yeqannach hallikluk bismartut, veyizzaher leqanneach beqal, velo yidchoq, pen yischot likluk habbalua babbeged, sheyyesh issur bischitato middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"k:

Abal beged sheen alayv likluk vetinnup, ap al pi shehushchar mechamat lebisha o tashmish — en omerim bo sheriyyato zehu kibbuso, umuttar litten alayv mayim muatim, abal lo merubbim, mishshum gezera shemma yabo lesochoto achar kak lehotzi memayv, ella im ken hu beged sheeno maqpid al memayv lesochotam mimmennu ap bechol, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheap beged sheen alayv shum likluk — sheriyyato zehu kibbuso, ap im libbuno matzhil meod. Velaken asur litten alayv apillu kol shehu mayim o shear mashqeh hamlabben ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lelibbun, di"pesiq resheh hu". Veyesh lachush ledibrehem lehachamir beshel tora (sheen zo melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, hoil umah shehabbeged mitlabben noach hu lo ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak, ayyen simman ra"ch). Ulepi zeh, mayim sheyyesh bahem tolaim — asur lishtotam al yede mappa beshabbat, ap al pi sheeno nishreh bemayim ella dabar muat mehammappa kede hannachat piv. Abal yesh meqillin ap lepi sebara zo bimat mayim, sheen omerim sheriyyato bahem zehu kibbuso (kesheeno mitkavven lelibbuno, velaken muttar lishtot hammayim al yede mappa, hoil velo nishreh ella dabar muat, veeno mitkavven lelibbun kelal. Veen limchot beyad hammeqillin, kevan shellisbara harishona muttar bekol inyan. Abal kol yere shamayim yachmir leatzmo shello liknos lispeq issur shel tora). Veen chilluq bekol zeh ben begadim lebanim litzbuim, sheggam bitzbuim shayyak issur kibbus kemo shennitbaer lemala, ben shehem shel pishtan ben shehem shel tzemer o meshi o shear minim. Umikkol maqom, ledibre hakkol en omerim bebeged sheen alayv likluk sheriyyato bemayim zehu kibbuso ella keshehu bederek niqqayon, abal im hu bederek likluk, kegon hammistappeg besadin achar harechitza, veken hamnaggeb yadayv bemappa achar hannetila, ap al pi sheyyesh rob mayim al gupo veal yadayv umatpiach hassadin vehammappa — en bezeh mishshum kibbus, sheeno kibbus ella likluk. Umittaam zeh hittiru leholek lidbar mitzva laabor bemayim bibgadayv, veen omerim sheriyyato zehu kibbuso, lepi shezzehu gam ken derek likluk keshemmakniso bemayim keshehu labush bahem, veeno derek niqqayon kelal. Veyesh machmirin shello yehe ribbuy mayim al yadayv, ella yenaggeben bekoach zo bezo lehasir mehem hammayim kepi yekolto qodem sheyyeqannecho bemappa. Vetob lachush ledibrehem bedabar sheen bo hepsed kelal. Abal hamminhag lehaqel. Veken iqqar. Velaken muttar lenaggeb yadayv bebeged shehittil alayv tinoq me raglayim kede lebattel et me raglayim behammayim sheyyabou alehem minniggub yadayv, al derek shennitbaer besimman a"z, veen bezeh mishshum kibbus, kevan shehu derek likluk al yede niggub yadayv velo derek niqqayon. Abal asur littol yadayv bemayim al hamme raglayim kede lebattelam, sheap shehammayim hayyoredim miyyadayv niqraim shopakim — en zeh niqra derek likluk, kevan shehem tzelulim ureuyim lekibbus, usheriyyatam zehu kibbusam, lepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer lemala, sheomerim sheriyyat beged zehu kibbuso ap kesheen alayv shum likluk vetinnup. Veim yesh al bigdo tzoa ushear dabar metunnap — asur lehaabiro apillu al yede niggub hayyadayim ap shehu derek likluk, kevan shemmaabir bezeh likluk yoter gadol, mah sheen ken beme raglayim sheeno maabirem mehabbeged al yede hanniggub, ella shemmebattelem umetaharem kede sheyyukal lehitpallel. Ulekattechilla tob lizzaher shello liqqach tinoq becheqo beshabbat im lo al kar:

Mi shennitlakleku yadayv betit — meqannechem biznab hassus o biznab happara, o bemappa haqqasha haasuya leechoz bah haqqotzim, abal lo bemappa shemmeqannechim bah hayyadayim, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol, veyabo lekabbes hammappa:

Kos shehaya bo mayim o yayin o shear mashqim apillu sheenam melabbenim — asur lenaggebo bemappa apillu im eno maqpid al memeha lesochotam, shekkevan shehakkos tzar — i epshar shello yischot qetzat mimmah sheyyibbala bemappa al yede hanniggub, veyesh bezeh issur middibre soperim, al kol panim, ap bemashqim sheenam melabbenim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"k. Abal muttar leqanneach hassapsal vekayyotze bebeged sheeno maqpid al memayv lesochoto achar haqqinnuach ap bechol. Abal muttar lenaggeb hayyadayim achar hannetila ap bebeged shemmaqpid al memayv (veken panayv), mippene shello gazeru kelal al zeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a (ayyen sham hattaam):

En mistakkelin beshabbat bemara shel matteket, shehi charipa keizmel vederek lehasir bah bechol et hannimin hamduldalin merosho uzeqano kesheroeh bah shehen meduldalin, veyesh lachush shemma yishkach shehu shabbat veyasir bah hannimin kedarko bechol. Veap im hu qabua umechubberet bakkotel — asur, shello chillequ chakamim bigzeratam bemara zo sheyyesh bah chashash zeh lipamim. Vegam hannashim asurot lehistakkel bemara zo, mippene sheddarkan bechol lehashshir bah searot lebanot mittok hashshechorot:
Abal muttar lehistakkel bemara sheen bah chashash zeh, apillu enah qabua, im hu beinyan sheen issur mishshum "lo yilbash geber simlat ishsha", al derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman qn"v:
